title: Genuine Zero Uniform Atlas Energy
description: Lean 4 formalization of the native real-camera/Genuine zero identity, the exact empirical C2--C7 camera geometry including the C4/C6 antipodal channels, the sharp critical cutoff-tail expansion with explicit remainder, the collective raw-energy expansion, and the exact logarithmic first/second cutoff jets generated by M^(-s-1). Version 0.10.0 proves that the exact scaled explicit-radius tail is holomorphic on a fixed critical neighborhood, establishes one uniform Cauchy-circle majorant, and derives explicit O(1/M) estimates for the scaled value, first complex derivative, and second complex derivative. These bounds feed the exact differentiated-remainder transport from version 0.9.0. Empirical cutoff-doubling campaigns are retained only as discovery and reproducibility provenance, not as proof dependencies.
